name: Default
shortDescription: Multi-model document, graph and key-value database with the AQL query language, a built-in web interface and persistent storage.

alerts.message: Sign in to the web interface as root with the generated ARANGO_ROOT_PASSWORD from the environment variables. The root user is created only on the first start, so changing the variable later has no effect.

Without a license key ArangoDB runs as the Community Edition under the ArangoDB Community License: commercial production use needs an Enterprise license, and a dataset over 100 GiB turns read-only and then shuts the server down.
